goal.objective: Implement a parent/child R2 trust boundary that materializes, installs, builds, binds, executes, re-verifies, cleans, and only then promotes evidence for one exact candidate without importing repository-live runtime modules.

assumptions.statement: The external host has provisioned the explicit content-addressed npm cache; release execution itself remains offline and fails closed if supply is incomplete.
assumptions.rationale: The observed probe proved both ENOTCACHED failure and a subsequent network-free exact-lock success.

assumptions.statement: The bootstrap binds observed bytes and isolates ordinary repository effects but does not defend against a compromised OS, executable, IDE, or hostile same-user process.
assumptions.rationale: Strong process and filesystem isolation remains an external host responsibility.

assumptions.statement: The integration owner retains full verification, successor freeze, one-shot gate, fresh R2, hosted CI, and merge authority.
assumptions.rationale: The correction producer cannot approve its own release.

assumptions.statement: Candidate 10, Revision 17, and every prior gate, package, approval, and handoff remain immutable.
assumptions.rationale: The replacement must create a new successor rather than rewrite failed evidence.

assumptions.statement: One specialist owns the coupled parent, child workers, package wiring, and tests; the integration owner independently reviews and runs release gates.
assumptions.rationale: The files share one trust protocol and require one coherent output-promotion boundary.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every R2 semantic output is attributable to one parent-verified exact candidate runtime, protected closures remain unchanged, and no evidence reaches the live repository before successful cleanup and promotion checks.

evidenceRequirements.description: Provide exact changed-file, bootstrap identity, offline-lock, runtime-binding, fresh-child, mutation, staging, cleanup, focused-test, full-check, and diff evidence.

forbiddenEffects: Do not edit outside declared write scope, modify immutable evidence, change core compiler or schema behavior, change dependencies or lockfile, change Git state, use network access, run lifecycle scripts, launch descendants, run a candidate gate, prepare R2 against a release candidate, claim release readiness, or merge.

module.action: Bind exact candidate tooling, install exact locked supply offline outside repository ancestry, build and bind generated runtime, execute one fresh child, reverify protected closures, clean, and atomically promote only allowed evidence.
